description: Secretary Office of Prime Minister - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16
categorisation: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by imposing restrictions on public movement in specified areas for a defined period. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a legally binding regulation for maintaining public order, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulatory frameworks and legal notices. While it mentions the Prime Minister's name and title, this is in the context of exercising legal authority to issue the order, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
